REI is a consumer-owned **cooperative (co-op)** , which means you don't "buy" the company like a publicly traded stock. However, you *can* buy a **lifetime REI Co-op Membership** or shop directly on their site.

Here are your main options:

1. **REI Co-op Lifetime Membership** : A one-time fee of **$30** gets you lifetime membership benefits, including annual member dividends (rewards), special member-only pricing, discounts on REI adventures and rentals, and used gear trade-ins. You can join on the REI Membership Page.
2. **REI Co-op Gear & Apparel** : Head over to the official [REI Co-op Website](https://www.rei.com/) to shop for outdoor clothing, camping gear, bikes, and skis.
3. **REI Gift Cards** : If you're buying for someone else, gift cards are available via retailers like the [$25 REI Gift Card on Target](https://www.target.com/p/rei-25-gift-card-email-delivery/-/A-52897804?TCID=OGS&AFID=google&CPNG=Seasonal&adgroup=276-3&srsltid=AYCX9vKSa_Jzh2PWKPlmML9gV3AuImGGfcRka87WiP8dfREkrob4DgN8rHg) or directly through REI.
